items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: Slim and I were invited out to Martha Raye's house to a party, and it was -- and George Raft, yeah.

ctx.x: Yes. I think, if I remember, Slim and I were invited out to Martha Raye's house to a party, and it was -- and George Raft, yeah. They were -- they had parties, you know, I was able to get in on, and it was great.
Now, did you play at those parties?
